answer: We define a decentralized haven where a zero-knowledge verifiable delay function regulates the consensus pulse, forcing agents to lock staking collateral in dynamic opportunity-cost bonds. By implementing a subgame-perfect slashing matrix, any identity multiplication attack yields negative expected utility, proving that malicious replication of identities cannot destabilize this microeconomic meadow. Consequently, the strategy profile of honest participation emerges as the unique, robust Nash equilibrium.
